headline: Basic Coverage
description: Covers Part A hospital coinsurance, Part B coinsurance or copayments, and the first 3 pints of blood.

headline: Basic + Part A Deductible
description: Everything in Plan A, plus coverage for the Medicare Part A deductible.

headline: Broad Coverage, No Part B Deductible
description: Covers hospital costs, Part B coinsurance, Part A deductible, and skilled nursing facility care.

headline: Most Comprehensive (Pre-2020 Only)
description: Covers the Part B deductible plus virtually all Medicare cost-sharing. Only available to those eligible before Jan 1, 2020.

headline: Most Popular Comprehensive Plan
description: Covers almost everything Plan F covers except the Part B deductible ($240 in 2024). Most popular for new enrollees.

headline: Lower Premium, 50% Cost-Sharing
description: Pays 50% of most cost-sharing items with an annual out-of-pocket cap.

headline: Lower Premium, 75% Cost-Sharing
description: Similar to Plan K but covers 75% of cost-sharing. Includes an out-of-pocket limit.

headline: Covers 50% of Part A Deductible
description: Covers Part B coinsurance, Part A coinsurance, skilled nursing, and 50% of the Part A deductible.

headline: Lower Premium, Small Copays
description: Covers most gaps but requires copays up to $20 for office visits and $50 for ER visits (if not admitted).
